title: Spain at the World Cup
description: La Roja and the tiki-taka era — Spain's World Cup journey.

questions.q: In which year did Spain win their only World Cup?
questions.explain: Spain won the 2010 World Cup in South Africa.

questions.q: Whose extra-time goal won Spain the 2010 final?
questions.explain: Iniesta scored the winner against the Netherlands.

questions.q: Who captained Spain as goalkeeper in 2010?
questions.explain: Casillas was captain and kept several clean sheets.

questions.q: As defending champions in 2014, Spain went out at which stage?
questions.explain: Spain were eliminated in the group stage in Brazil 2014.

questions.q: Who managed Spain to the 2010 title?
questions.explain: Vicente del Bosque led Spain to glory in 2010.

questions.q: Spain's possession-based style of that era is popularly called…
Spain were knocked out of the 2022 World Cup on penalties by whom?
questions.explain: Morocco beat Spain on penalties in the round of 16.

questions.q: Which striker is among Spain's all-time leading World Cup scorers?
questions.explain: David Villa is Spain's record World Cup goalscorer.

questions.q: Who was Spain's top scorer at the 2010 World Cup with five goals?
questions.explain: David Villa was Spain's standout striker with five goals across the tournament, including strikes against Portugal, Paraguay and Chile.

questions.q: Which city hosted the 2010 World Cup final where Spain beat the Netherlands?
questions.explain: The 2010 final was played at Soccer City (now FNB Stadium) in Johannesburg — the largest stadium in Africa — where Iniesta struck in extra time.
